name: recent-prompts
description: Shows your last two messages above the prompt and a searchable history pane; click one to scroll the transcript to it.

questions.title: Keep questions asked with the picker
questions.description: List the questions Claude asks you with the picker, and what you picked, among its replies.

plans.title: Keep plans
plans.description: List the plans Claude submits for your approval among its replies.

files.title: Keep files sent to you
files.description: List the files Claude sends you (caption and file names) among its replies.

notifications.title: Keep push notifications
notifications.description: List the push notifications Claude sends you among its replies.

commands.title: Keep slash commands
commands.description: List the slash commands and skills you run as messages, with what they printed as their reply.
